thread.title: Magical Girl Raising Project restart • Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku restart - Episode 8 discussion

opinions.point: Some viewers appreciated the broader ensemble focus and richer character relationships.
Several commenters found the mystery-oriented direction engaging and enjoyed speculating about character motives.
A number of viewers felt the slower, less lethal structure suited the larger cast, while others thought it lacked the first season’s intensity.
Some described the episode as boring and criticized its slow macro pacing.
Multiple commenters considered the current season less emotionally powerful and less twist-driven than the first.
Character discussion was generally more favorable, though at least one character was viewed as underwritten or ineffective.
